name: Kawah Ijen
hookId: Private trip Kawah Ijen: nikmati pendakian tengah malam, saksikan api biru elektrik, dan sunrise di atas danau asam pirus tanpa repot.
hookEn: Venture into the volcanic craters of East Java to experience a midnight trek to the world-famous electric blue fire and witness sunrise over a turquoise acid lake.
